description: The GLE's diesel V6 shares the same swirl flap and injector wear pattern documented across the wider Mercedes OM642 family, including E-Class and S-Class applications. We replace worn swirl flaps and injectors as standard.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: OM651 injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Mercedes specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
